sections.label: A
sections.title: Listen and write the letter.
sections.note: Listen carefully and choose a, b, or c.

questions.explanation: Inhale means to breathe air into your lungs. The correct letter is b.
A virus is a tiny infectious agent that can cause illness. The correct letter is c.
Shrink means to become smaller. The correct letter is c.
The common cold is a frequent viral illness. The correct letter is a.

sections.label: B
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the word bank: virus, swallowed, dead, expand, scrape, infect. One word is extra.

questions.prompt: 1. The top layer of our skin is made up of ___ cells.
questions.explanation: The outer layer contains dead skin cells that are continually replaced.

questions.prompt: 2. Something that can produce sickness is a ___.
questions.explanation: A virus can enter living cells and cause an infection.

questions.prompt: 3. She ___ her medicine. She'll feel better soon.
questions.explanation: Swallowed is the past form of swallow: she took the medicine into her body through her mouth.

questions.prompt: 4. You can ___ another person if you touch them when you are sick.
questions.explanation: Infect means to pass a disease-causing organism to another person.

questions.prompt: 5. A balloon will ___ if you blow into it.
questions.explanation: Expand means to become larger as air fills the balloon.

sections.label: C
sections.title: Complete the sentences with the correct words. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Write the missing word, then choose picture a, b, c, or d. The labels are below the clean original illustrations.

questions.prompt: 1. Scientists use a ___ to study different kinds of sicknesses.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: A microscope makes very small objects visible for scientific study.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Kính hiển vi ở hình a.

questions.prompt: 2. We can't see the ___ in our body. They are too small.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: Cells are the tiny basic units that make up living things.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows body cells.

questions.prompt: 3. I am ___ to the flu, but my friend isn't.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: If you are immune to an illness, your body can resist it.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Hình b minh họa immune: không bị cúm.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: Common cold is the fixed name for this frequent respiratory illness.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Hình d minh họa common cold: bạn nhỏ đang bị cảm.

sections.label: D
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences.
sections.note: Use correct adjective order and punctuation.

questions.prompt: 1. purple / I / backpack / big, / have / a
answers: I have a big purple backpack
I have a big, purple backpack
questions.explanation: Size comes before color: a big purple backpack.

questions.prompt: 2. keys / small, / box / wooden / the / are / old, / in / The
answers: The keys are in the small old wooden box
The keys are in the small, old, wooden box
questions.explanation: The adjectives follow the order size + age + material: small, old, wooden.

questions.prompt: 3. sunset / saw / orange / We / the / beautiful,
answers: We saw the beautiful orange sunset
We saw the beautiful, orange sunset
questions.explanation: The sentence begins with the subject We, followed by saw and the noun phrase the beautiful, orange sunset.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Check the correct answer.
sections.note: Choose the adjective order that sounds natural in English.

questions.prompt: 1. The scientist wears a ___ lab coat.
questions.explanation: Condition comes before color: clean, white.

questions.prompt: 2. He saw the ___ virus in the microscope.
questions.explanation: Size normally comes before quality or effect here: tiny, dangerous.

questions.prompt: 3. The dog had a ___ bark.
questions.explanation: The source answer uses loud, scary: the sound is first described by volume, then by its effect.

questions.prompt: 4. I ate a ___ orange.
questions.explanation: Opinion comes before shape: delicious, round.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Write a complete sentence, adding a comma where necessary, then choose picture a, b, or c.

questions.prompt: 1. big / house / We / new / a / have / wood

parts.label: Sentence
answers: We have a big new wood house
We have a big, new, wood house
parts.explanation: Use subject + have + noun phrase. The adjectives follow size + age + material.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows the house.

questions.prompt: 2. swallowed / the / red / medicine / bad-tasting / I

parts.label: Sentence
answers: I swallowed the bad-tasting red medicine
I swallowed the bad-tasting, red medicine
parts.explanation: Opinion or taste comes before color: bad-tasting, red medicine.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture a shows the child swallowing medicine.

questions.prompt: 3. see / fascinating / cells / I / the / round / tiny / can

parts.label: Sentence
answers: I can see the fascinating tiny round cells
I can see the fascinating, tiny, round cells
parts.explanation: The order is opinion + size + shape: fascinating, tiny, round.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture b shows tiny round cells.

sections.label: I
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use each anatomical picture to identify the missing word.

questions.prompt: 1. Your ___ beats quickly when you are excited.
questions.explanation: The heart is the muscular organ that pumps blood around the body.

questions.prompt: 2. You can sometimes see your ___ under your skin.
questions.explanation: Veins are blood vessels that carry blood back toward the heart.

questions.prompt: 3. I can feel my ___ move when I breathe.
questions.explanation: The diaphragm is the muscle below the lungs that moves during breathing.

questions.prompt: 4. When I inhale, air goes into my ___.
questions.explanation: The lungs are the organs where the body takes in oxygen.

sections.label: J
sections.title: Unscramble and match.
sections.note: Unscramble the body word, then choose its definition.

questions.prompt: 1. t e s i a e r r

parts.label: Unscrambled word
parts.explanation: The letters form arteries.

parts.label: Definition
options: a. The heart does this to move blood around the body.
b. This is a tube in your neck that lets air into your lungs.
c. This is a group of body parts that work together.
d. These are like tubes and carry blood from the heart.
answers: d. These are like tubes and carry blood from the heart.
parts.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, so they match d.

questions.prompt: 2. h r a t a e c

parts.label: Unscrambled word
parts.explanation: The letters form trachea.

parts.label: Definition
options: a. The heart does this to move blood around the body.
b. This is a tube in your neck that lets air into your lungs.
c. This is a group of body parts that work together.
d. These are like tubes and carry blood from the heart.
answers: b. This is a tube in your neck that lets air into your lungs.
parts.explanation: The trachea is the windpipe, so it matches b.

questions.prompt: 3. m s e y s t

parts.label: Unscrambled word
parts.explanation: The letters form system.

parts.label: Definition
options: a. The heart does this to move blood around the body.

c. This is a group of body parts that work together.
d. These are like tubes and carry blood from the heart.
answers: c. This is a group of body parts that work together.

parts.label: Definition
options: a. The heart does this to move blood around the body.
b. This is a tube in your neck that lets air into your lungs.
c. This is a group of body parts that work together.

sections.label: K
sections.title: Check the correct answer.
sections.note: Choose used to for a past habit or state that has changed; use the simple past for a finished event.

questions.prompt: 1. I ___ my bike to school. Now I go by bus.
questions.explanation: Now I go by bus shows that the earlier repeated habit changed, so use used to ride.

questions.prompt: 2. She ___ very early yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: Yesterday morning is one finished time, so use the simple past woke up.

questions.prompt: 3. Phillip plays basketball after school now, but he ___ chess.
questions.explanation: Now contrasts a present habit with a different past habit, so use used to play.

questions.prompt: 4. They ___ every day last week.
questions.explanation: Last week is a finished time period, so use the simple past went swimming.

sections.label: L
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Use used to where possible.
sections.note: Use the word bank: make, watch, play, hate, go. Select used to only for a past habit or state contrasted with the present.

questions.prompt: 1. She ___ vegetables, but now she likes them.
questions.explanation: The contrast with now shows a past state that changed: used to hate.

questions.prompt: 2. I ___ a lot of TV last week because I was sick.
questions.explanation: Last week is a finished time, so use the simple past watched.

questions.prompt: 3. We ___ to the movies, but now we're too busy.
questions.explanation: The contrast with now shows a past habit that changed: used to go.

questions.prompt: 4. Yesterday, he ___ a cake for my birthday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday identifies one finished event, so use the simple past made.

sections.label: M
sections.title: Complete the sentences for each set of pictures.
sections.note: Use the simple present for picture a (now) and used to for picture b (past).

questions.prompt: 1. walk

parts.label: a. I ___ to school today.
parts.explanation: Today describes the present routine, so use the simple present walk.

parts.label: b. I ___ to school.
parts.explanation: The past picture shows an old habit, so use used to walk.

questions.prompt: 2. think

parts.label: a. I ___ exercise is boring.
parts.explanation: This is the person's present opinion, so use think.

parts.label: b. I ___ exercise was boring.
parts.explanation: This was the person's earlier opinion, so use used to think.

questions.prompt: 3. play

parts.label: a. He ___ soccer every day.
parts.explanation: He is third-person singular, so the simple present verb takes -s: plays.

parts.label: b. He ___ soccer years ago.
parts.explanation: Years ago and the past picture describe an earlier habit, so use used to play.
